dedupe_keys.name: vyhlasena zaplavova uzemi pro staletou vodu

description: Vyhlášená záplavová území pro staletou vodu is a dataset listed in Czech National Open Data Portal, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Jihomoravský kraj. Floodplains for centuries-old water in the South Moravian Region. ZU - the name of the floodplain of hundred-year-old water Datevyhl - publication date area/m2 - area in m2 perimeter/m - perimeter given in m. Coverage: Jihomoravský kraj. The portal shows the English title as "Declared floodplains for centuries-old water" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Jihomoravský kraj. Its keywords include Záplavová území, Jihomoravský kraj. The listing shows 4 download or service links in SHP, KML, GEOJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://data.gov.cz/zdroj/datové-sady/70888337/678046544/distribuce/32da936ac91240ffc925a5a91ab1ce79/podmínky-užití). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nkod-opendata-cz.
